# PROOF CALENDAR

*Generated by `scripts/proof_calendar.py` from the box read of 2026-10-29T05:17:33Z. Never edited by hand; regenerate with the `proof_calendar_read` box task, then `--input`.*

**Method.** Rate = judged units per active day over the trailing 14 days; the future walks the real season windows (zero accrual outside them); interval = 10th-90th percentile of a Gamma(k+0.5, active_days) posterior on that rate. Applies when the last 14 days are representative of the season; does not for lumpy schedules (NFL byes) or a ramp-up window. NFL regular season ends 2027-01-10 (EXP-041 s.4); MLB pauses after the World Series (~2026-11-01) until ~2027-03-25 (EXP-042); NBA/NHL window ends are the usual calendar, not a published schedule (assumption).

**49 calibration-engine cells + 15 frozen hypotheses = 64 rows.** A projected date is when to LOOK, not a prediction of the verdict; no score is read below the judged n.
